title: Chapter 911
paragraphs: Chapter 911
Episode 228. Battle of Grosh Castle (7)
Hot...! Veil's face heated up.
‘...Was what I said so strange? It seems like that Murakan guy will keep making fun of me. Damn, it's embarrassing how I boasted about taking everything down myself if need be.’

The sense of crisis had vanished without a trace, and he was left with a feeling of mortification that made him feel like he could go mad. That's how reliable the two of them seemed to be, enough to make the Demon King who received Jito's divine weapon pale in comparison.
“Tsk! Both Soga and Murakan have had many experiences transforming into beasts!”
[No, you didn't. Even if you did, you wouldn't, you brat, sure.]
Jin didn't answer, only shrugged his shoulders
. In fact, it was true.
‘I expected those guys to join the battlefield, damn it. It was a critical moment to strike the remnants of the Sun God.’
‘This pressure... what is it? It feels like a power that only those who've reached the extreme end should have.’
‘I now understand why the first line of defense fell so easily...’
Unlike Veil, the Demon Kings felt as if they had a sword hanging over their necks. Already, Veil was showing a completely healthy expression as if he had never been affected by an illusion spell.
What about the sealing spell and curse that were about to engulf Veil?
Murakan was bending the seal using his two hands and wings, as if dealing with clutter, and Jin was swatting away the curse like chasing a fly.
‘These crazy! Are they really humans? They are neutralizing the seals and curses that we, the thirteen, unleashed with such a primitive method?’

‘Calm down... I need to calm down. Jin Runkandel and Murakan definitely retreated when the Archive Organization used flesh. The divine weapon that Zito has now enhanced us with should be at that level. It's worth a try...!’
Each of the Demon Kings calculated what was to come.
Jin and Murakan looked down at their enemies, erasing any signs of laughter.

[Are your masters still flesh-bound? The day Sakiel used flesh, I felt a considerable amount of energy, but now it seems like a frog has turned into a poison frog. The magic doesn't seem refreshing either, what's this, huh? Tsk, I crumpled it up because undoing the seal was bothersome, and it broke down.]
“Murakan, you dare to insult Zito's divine weapon...!”
Gwaaaaaah-!
Murakan unleashed his breath before the Demon King finished speaking.

[What I want to say while fighting is my business, it's always allowed for the strong. In other words, from now on, you guys are too busy trying to struggle with your mouths shut. And as for insults, it would be more insulting for you guys who are only worth this much even with my flesh, if I were Zito.]
Kwaa, Kwaah, hooong...!

Murakan released his breath consecutively, releasing his divine energy. The protagonist who made the first battle into a nightmare for the demons, the black confinement, spread all around again, engulfing the demons.
At the same time, a surge of energy exploded from Jin. Each time the beam of light from his heart pulsated, lightning struck, vanishing ordinary soldiers without a trace.
It wasn't a special technique he had used. It was just the lightning that occurred as he drew energy for his weapon, the King's Sword.
"What are you doing?"
The enemies thought Jin's comment was intended to mock their surprised faces. However, Jin wasn't addressing the demon kings, but Veil.
[Huh? Me?]

"Yeah, you, who become stronger when fighting with a sword rather than with divine powers. Are you going to continue to be shocked just because we had a little fun? Fight, we're planning to wipe out at least up to the third defense line this time. More allies will join us soon."
[Oh, yeah, I should fight.]
Veil again confirmed his golden powers unfolding as he desired. Jin and Murakan had quickly neutralized the energy of Zito that had been suppressing him.
Of course, Zito's energy was not entirely extinguished. Just that the effect that the demon kings had hoped for could never be achieved.
Sufficient energy had gathered in his heart. As if Jin had no intention of prolonging the fight, he immediately launched his divine technique, the King's Sword.
Tenth Form of the King's Sword Divine Technique
Sovereign Ruling Sword – Open
[Those at the first defense line or you guys. You're all dying due to an excessive sword.]
Jin's increasingly deep voice crushed the battlefield. The green lightning spreading from him had already replaced the sky and sea.

The common soldiers merely looking directly into the lightning found their eyes bursting and their bodies burning, unable to even scream. The speed at which their bodies ignited was faster than their mouths opening to groan.
"Argh!"
At least the demon leaders were able to withstand the lightning for a moment. Of course, for most, it was just a matter of holding on for a few meaningless seconds.
The unstoppable disaster formed by the combination of golden divine power, spiritual energy, and lightning.
There was no one to rescue the demons that fell into it. It was a situation where, unlike during the first battle, other demon kings could not send more support.

Not only here, but the entire Glosche Castle was under attack. Sariel was summoning demons from the headquarters without rest to replenish the forces that were depleting much faster than expected. He didn't even have the energy to look over the battlefield with the crystal ball and command.
"The, the divine power of Lord Zito is being pushed back!"
"We, we need more sacrifices, I will become the sacrifice……!"
Higher demons were volunteering to become sacrifices, desperately hurling their bodies near the demon kings. They were trying to catalyze the cycle magic and dark magic of the demon kings.
A fanatical loyalty towards Zito was making them into such lowly beings.

Jin decided to put an end to them before they could be used as sacrifices. It was a naturally occurring outcome as long as he did not lose sight of the demon kings in his field of vision. Because where his eyes landed, the lightning energy gathered most horrifically.
The demon kings who comparatively had lower combat power showed an opening while enduring his gaze. To show an opening in front of Jin meant imminent death.

Moreover, with Murakan and Veil present, they had no chance of survival through any lucky coincidence. As they hurriedly tried to regain their stance, the lightning energy had already ripped through their bodies, and at the moment they recognized their death, dark chains and sword energy tore through their corpses.
Thus, in a blink of an eye, four demon kings lost their lives, and nearly half of the troops vanished. In human terms, several countries had been destroyed in just about thirty minutes.
It was an overwhelming event that could not, in any way, be termed as a battle.
The second round was also going the same way as the previous battle.
[Don't resent me too much, in some ways, I might be helping you.]
"What nonsense are you spouting...!"
Telbit screamed. He was making desperate attempts to cause even a little bit of damage to the three of them while being cornered. But all his efforts were resulting in failure.
[In my eyes, death seems better than a life subservient to Zito. Unfortunately, it may be a difficult concept for you to understand.]
"Cough!"
Telbit's eyes burst. Because he was trying to maintain the formation desperately without knowing that the demon king who was assisting him just next to him had just died.
The demon kings would have been better off not taking Zito's flesh from the beginning.
Then even if they died, Zito wouldn't have lost that much power permanently.

'I had the thought earlier, but I don't know what Zito's intentions are. From the situations that have been revealed so far, it's as if...he is giving his subordinates false hope using the flesh. And he doesn't care whether the subordinates waste his flesh and die.'
Or perhaps he wants his subordinates to suffer as well.
Suddenly, such a thought crossed his mind. Maybe what Zito is trying to immerse in 'pain' is not only limited to humanity.
Now, the remaining demon kings are eight.
They didn't stand a chance even when there were thirteen, so naturally, they have no chance of winning now. Besides, Jin, Murakan, and Veil didn't show any signs of fatigue.
There was no need to waste energy to end the already won battle faster. In the alliance, these three are not the only ones who can overwhelm such enemies.
It was right to conserve as much energy as possible before confronting the strongest class of demon kings like Paelito.
Jin began to retract his Myeong Wang Sovereign Sword.
Even without a tiring sword like the Royal Ruling Sword, the remaining enemies could be wiped out easily.
Moreover, it was about time for other superhumans from the Barmel Union to start appearing at the second defense line.
Woong-!
The vibration unique to space leap was felt. A red owl was appearing behind Jin.
"Sogaju, on my way here, I found a big street cat and brought it along. It looked pretty good at fighting. It seemed to actually do something too."
"Hoo, Vanessa. You're always too much. Can't you stop calling it a street cat? The enemies will hear it too. Don't I have dignity too?"
It was Vanessa and Hedo.
"What's the problem with being a little embarrassed? None of them will survive to remember your nickname anyway. Isn't that right, Sogaju?"
Vanessa drew her sword with a chilly smile.
"I guess so."
"Runcandel knight Vanessa Olson, starting annihilation."
As soon as Jin nodded, Vanessa's sword energy swept over the battlefield. Hedo also began a rough charge towards the remaining demon kings, scattering his sword dance.

In this way, the superhumans of the union were going to continue to be added to the battlefield. When Jin and Murakan, along with the superhumans, broke the defense line and opened the way, the barrier would advance as much.
Furthermore, not only was the front defense line to have more superhumans added.
On the right defense line where the front lines of Runcandel and Ziep were slightly tangled, Frog Mot was opening a white dimensional gate.
"I've heard that the front defense line has been quite fiercely broken through by the youngest, but this side is still quiet."
"It's going to get noisy from now on, third generation."
Runtia, Luna, and Sirius. The three were emerging from a different world. As soon as they saw Ziep's fleet deployed on the battlefield, they shrugged their shoulders.
"The command is to avoid combat with Ziep as much as possible, but with so many ships, it's going to be cumbersome."
Luna said, looking at the fleet.
Currently, the one commanding the breakthrough of Ziep's right defense line was the Deputy Admiral, Kun. Kun was also watching the three.
"You are, Kun. Was that the name?"
Luna spoke first.
"...That's right, White Whale."

"Listen carefully, I'm giving a friendly warning for the first time today. I'm going to break the defense line from now on. So if you don't want to lose your ships in the aftermath, move them away now."
